faults.name: wrong_reagent
faults.record_recovery: abort before aspiration; quarantine if dispense occurred

faults.name: tip_missing_or_dropped
faults.record_recovery: abort; replace tip; evaluate plate exposure

faults.name: clog_or_air_aspiration
faults.record_recovery: mark dose uncertain; repeat only if protocol allows

faults.name: well_misregistration
faults.record_recovery: quarantine affected plate; do not silently correct provenance

must_not_assume: morphology image directly equals biological state

faults.name: out_of_focus
faults.record_recovery: re-seat/refocus/reacquire; retain rejected image in audit trail
faults.twin: autofocus runs before every acquisition, so a refocus is part of each attempt; at the same field and seating a repeat is deterministic

must_not_assume: nominal setpoint equals actual culture exposure without sensor evidence

faults.name: temperature_excursion
faults.record_recovery: alarm; update Culture SDT; evaluate admissibility/quarantine

faults.name: unauthorized_release
faults.record_recovery: stop workflow; trace all affected material

rules.name: quarantine-of-the-contradicted
rules.because: containing a plate whose identity is contradicted is the treatment, not something it may block

rules.name: contradiction
rules.because: two observations disagree; nothing that depends on the item may proceed

rules.name: no-belief
rules.because: no belief at all: sense if a sensor can, otherwise refuse the step

rules.name: stale
rules.because: the observation predates a session boundary (kernel freshness rule F2)

rules.name: prediction
rules.because: a projection may guide planning, never a commitment

rules.name: reported-by-a-qualified-instrument
rules.because: a device report counts when the device's binding for it is validated

rules.name: reported
rules.because: an unqualified report is not enough for a consequential step

rules.name: assumed-consequential
rules.because: a consequential step may not rest on a default

rules.name: weak-routine
rules.because: routine use of a weaker belief is allowed and recorded

rules.name: inferred-consequential
rules.because: an inference is enough only where the contract says so
